products.name: CargoPack System
products.note: Bag + carbon rack + mounts (what hangs on the bike). Estimated from Tailfin AeroPack Carbon 18L-class systems (~900-1100 g); no remembered CargoPack figure. Written from general knowledge without web access; not checked against the maker's published figure.

products.name: CargoPack Top Bag
products.note: Top bag only, no rack. Estimated as roughly 45% of an ~1000 g 18 L rack-top system, by comparison with Tailfin AeroPack bag-only weights. Written from general knowledge without web access; not checked against the maker's published figure.

products.name: SpeedPack System
products.note: Bag + lightweight rack/mounts (what hangs on the bike). Scaled down from ~1000 g 18 L AeroPack-class systems for a 10 L seatpost-style rack system. Written from general knowledge without web access; not checked against the maker's published figure.

products.name: SpeedPack Top Bag
